_comment: Known problems by hardware, shown on the Support screen (local table, nothing is fetched). match: every condition named must hold. os: windows|linux. vendor: NVIDIA|AMD|Intel. gpu: regexes on the Vulkan device name. driver: regex on 'driverName driverInfo'. vram_gb_max / vram_gb_min: device-local memory in GiB (discrete GPUs). issues: GitHub issue numbers. 2026-11-23: removed 'ampere-windows' (RTX 30 flickering lights and smoke: came from reading GPU results ahead, now always off) and 'vram-4gb' (texture memory running out on 4 GB cards: the automatic VRAM budget and the automatic night lighting size now fit small cards).

title.en: AMD RX 580 / Polaris on Windows: crash in amdvlk64.dll
title.pt: AMD RX 580 / Polaris no Windows: crash em amdvlk64.dll

what.en: The game can close with a crash at amdvlk64.dll+0xebbbb. Update the AMD driver to the latest version. If it still happens, turn on Advanced settings (bottom left) and try the switch BP09 ("1D as 2D") on the Fixes tab.
what.pt: O jogo pode fechar com crash em amdvlk64.dll+0xebbbb. Atualize o driver da AMD para o mais recente. Se continuar, ligue Configurações avançadas (embaixo à esquerda) e tente a chave BP09 ("1D como 2D") na aba Correções.

title.en: NVIDIA Maxwell / Quadro: may be below the minimum
title.pt: NVIDIA Maxwell / Quadro: pode ficar abaixo do mínimo

what.en: This generation of GPU may be below the minimum the port needs, and the game can run poorly or not start. Tell us what you see.
what.pt: Essa geração de GPU pode ficar abaixo do mínimo que o port precisa, e o jogo pode rodar mal ou nem abrir. Conte o que você viu.
